slides.title: 4 license renewal myths that cost businesses

slides.myth: The state will always remind me before my license expires.
slides.fact: Some agencies send notices, many don't, and mail gets lost. The deadline is still on you.

slides.myth: There's a grace period, so a few days late is fine.
slides.fact: Not always. Many licenses lapse the day they expire, and working on a lapsed one can lead to fines.

slides.myth: Renewing takes five minutes, so I'll do it last minute.
slides.fact: Renewals can need CE credits, inspections or new insurance docs. Those take weeks.

slides.myth: Our office manager has it all in her head.
slides.fact: Until she's on vacation or moves on. Dates belong in a system, not one person's memory.

slides.title: Stop guessing on deadlines
slides.body: CertTrack tracks every license, permit and policy and alerts you before anything expires.
